title: Throughput Scenario Weaver for batch+cache decisioning
creator: Marta Lopez
description: Design and prototype an interactive "Throughput Scenario Weaver" — a compact console surface that lets engineers and platform owners compose hypothetical workload slices and immediately see recommended batching+cache configurations, cost/latency tradeoffs, and safety guardrails. Focus is on fast experimentation (modify arrival rate, sequence length distribution, cache hit rate) and explainable recommendations that tie to rollout presets and canary guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Weaver mock allows users to set 3 input axes: request rate (rps), median seq length, and prefix reuse (cache hit %)
UI surfaces at least 3 recommended profiles (aggressive, balanced, conservative) with one-click apply to a route
Each recommendation displays estimated 95th p99 latency, tokens/unit cost delta, and confidence band with explanation
Guardrail annotations appear when a recommendation risks outcome (e.g., latency > SLO or quality degradation), with suggested mitigations
Prototype has accessible keyboard interactions and color-blind friendly heatmap palette
Design handoff artifacts (Figma frames + interaction spec) uploaded and linked in ticket
design_feedback: PM review (2025-02-25): prefer conservative profile to be default for new routes until rollout telemetry is available
Eng review (2025-02-27): we need clear mapping of toggles to runtime flags (batcher size cap, cache TTL, prefill behavior) — ENG-19862 to implement API
Accessibility audit (2025-03-03): heatmap needs >=4.5 contrast for key labels; added alternate pattern overlay for colorblind mode
decisions: Show three recommendation tiers only (aggressive/balanced/conservative) to reduce cognitive load
Expose an "Advanced" panel with numeric knobs for experienced users; defaults keep the simplified UX
Recommendations calculated client-side for prototype using sampled telemetry, but final product will call a recommendation service (ENG-20103)
progress_updates: 2025-02-20: Ticket created and initial problem framing documented
2025-02-22: Low-fi sketches completed and shared with PM and Eng for alignment
2025-02-25: Figma first pass with three panes: Inputs | Heatmap & Profiles | Explanation cards

2025-03-03: Accessibility pass done; prototype wired to mock telemetry for demo
next_steps: Finalize interaction spec and copy for explanation cards (owner: Aisha)
Pair with ENG on API contract for applying a profile to a route (week of 2025-03-10)
Run 1-on-1 usability session with 4 platform engineers and capture metrics (time-to-config, confidence)
Add telemetry hooks for rollout feedback loop (track apply -> latency change -> rollback)
accessibility_considerations: Color palette uses patterns for heatmap (stripes/dots) for colorblindness
All interactive controls keyboard-focusable with 4:1 focus ring
Explanations include aria-describedby anchors for assistive tech
user_flows: Flow A: New user lands on Route -> opens Weaver -> selects balanced -> clicks apply -> guided canary setup
Flow B: Power user opens Advanced -> tweaks max batch size -> observes estimated cost delta -> exports JSON config
